g.text: Speaker and consulting fees are 65% of GLP-1 promotional dollars

text.style: font-size: 9.69px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Promotional payments naming each brand, $ millions per year

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Payments naming several products split equally across them; royalties, grants, acquisitions and other non-promotional payments excluded. Fees go to a few thousand speakers; meals reach

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: far more physicians (28% of dollars). 2025 Lilly meal records drop sharply in November–December (unexplained). Cells with fewer than 11 recipients withheld.

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Source: CMS Open Payments (general payments, promotional natures), 2013–2025.
